newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore Gas Q3 earnings per shr slips.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore Gas Q3 earnings per shr slips.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: First Call Q3 earnings per share estimate: $0.97.
The full name of the company is Baltimore Gas and Electric Co.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1995 Q3 includes charge of $0.07 per share after-tax writeoff of construction work in progress costs associated with constructing the remainder of the first combined cycle generating unit at BGE's Perryman site.

1996 nine month period includes the impact of the disallowance of $6.8 million ($.03 per share after-tax) in replacement energy costs incurred during the 1987 outages at Calvert Cliffs Nuclear Power Plant.
Q3 net income per share from businesses outside utilities: $0.07 vs $0.08.
Nine month net income per share from businesses outside utilities: $0.21 vs $0.14.
Earnings per share for 12 months ended September 30: $2.20 vs $1.99. Revenues for 12 months ended September 30: $3.14 billion vs $2.82 billion.
